# Coverage at genes transcribed by RNA Polymerase II

```{r load-rna-pol-ii-table, eval=TRUE}
rpii.cov_columns <- c("library", "seqid", "position", "strand", "feature", "coverage")
rpii.cov_df <- readr::read_tsv(file=p.rpii.cov_file,
                               col_names = rpii.cov_columns) %>% 
  mutate(library = gsub(pattern = "[[:punct:]]",
                        replacement = '-',
                        x = library)) %>% 
  filter(! library %in% p.libs_for_filtering)

rpii.gene_df <- readr::read_tsv(file=p.rpii.feature_bed_file,
                               col_names = c("seqid", "start", "stop", "feature", "strand")) %>% 
  group_by(feature) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  filter(id == 2) %>% # Grab just the true coordinates of the gene. 1 & 3 correspond to buffer regions.
  select(feature, start, stop) %>% 
  mutate(length = stop - start)
```

```{r test-rna-pol-ii-table, eval=FALSE}
row_count <- 6000

replicate_items <- function(items, total_count) {
  is.wholenumber <- function(n)
    return(round(n) == n)

  frac <- total_count / length(items)
  if (!is.wholenumber(frac))
    stop(
      paste("total_count is not divisible by number of items:", frac)
    )
  unlist(lapply(items, rep.int, frac))
}

rpii.cov_df <- data.frame(
  library = replicate_items(c('lib_abc'), row_count),
  seqid = replicate_items(c('chr1'), row_count),
  strand = replicate_items(c('+'), row_count),
  rel_position = seq.int(from = 0, length.out = row_count, by = 2),
  coverage = round(rnorm(row_count, mean = 3, sd = 3)),
  feature = replicate_items(c('gene1', 'gene2', 'gene3'), row_count)
) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    feature = gsub(pattern = "^gene-", replacement = "", x = feature)
  )

rpii.gene_df <- data.frame(
  feature = c('gene1', 'gene2', 'gene3'),
  start = c(0, 1000, 2000),
  stop = c(1000, 2000, 3000),
  length = c(1000, 1000, 1000)
)

rpii.nucleosome_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  path = "data/input/13059_2018_1398_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx"
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    "Nucleosome_up" = "+1 nucleosome",
    "Nucleosome_down" = "-1 nucleosome"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(ORF, Chr, TSS, TTS, Nucleosome_up, Nucleosome_down)
  

```

```{r prepare-rpii-coverage-dataframe}
buffer_length_bp <- 500

prep_position_wise_feature_coverage_df <- function(df,
                                                   gene_df,
                                                   min_gene_read_count = 1,
                                                   min_gene_coverage = 0,
                                                   min_feature_length = buffer_length_bp * 2,
                                                   add_zero_coverage_positions = TRUE,
                                                   summarise_by_position = TRUE) {
  input_gene_count <- nrow(gene_df)
  feature_length_list <- gene_df %>% 
    filter(length >= min_feature_length) %>% 
    pull(feature)
  message(
    paste("Dropped", input_gene_count - length(feature_length_list), "genes shorter than", min_feature_length, "bp")
  )
  
  feature_cov_list <- df %>% 
    group_by(library, feature) %>%
    summarise(
      read_total = sum(coverage.raw),
      coverage_total = sum(coverage),
      .groups = "keep"
    ) %>% 
    filter(
      read_total >= min_gene_read_count,
      coverage_total >= min_gene_coverage
    ) %>% 
    pull(feature) %>% 
    unique()
  message(
    paste("Dropped", input_gene_count - length(feature_cov_list), "low-coverage genes")
  )
  
  feature_list <- base::intersect(feature_length_list, feature_cov_list)
  message(
    paste("Analyzing ", length(feature_list), "/",  input_gene_count, " genes", sep = "")
  )
  
  result_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      feature %in% feature_list
    ) %>%
    left_join(gene_df,
              by = "feature") %>% 
    mutate(
      rel_position = case_when(
        start + buffer_length_bp > position ~ position - start,
        stop - buffer_length_bp < position ~ position - stop + (2 * buffer_length_bp),
        .default = NA
      ),
      rel_position = case_when(
        strand == '-' ~ (rel_position * -1) +  (2 * buffer_length_bp),
        .default = rel_position
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(rel_position)
    ) %>%
    select(library, seqid, rel_position, strand, feature, coverage)

  if (add_zero_coverage_positions == TRUE) {
    result_df <- result_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(library, seqid, strand, feature) %>%
      tidyr::expand(rel_position = seq.int(from = buffer_length_bp * -1,
                                           to = buffer_length_bp * 3)) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(coverage = NA) %>% 
      left_join(result_df,
                by = c("library", "seqid", "strand", "feature", "rel_position"),
                suffix = c("_df1", "_df2")) %>%
      mutate(
        coverage = coalesce(coverage_df1, coverage_df2),
        coverage = coalesce(coverage, 0)
      ) %>%
      select(!all_of(c("coverage_df1", "coverage_df2")))
  }
  
  if (summarise_by_position == TRUE) {
    result_df <- result_df %>% 
      group_by(library, rel_position) %>% 
      dplyr::reframe(coverage = sum(coverage),
                     .groups = "keep")
  }
  
  if (nrow(result_df) == 0)
    stop("All genes dropped by filtering thresholds.")
  return(result_df)
}
```

```{r define-gene-position-coverage-plotting-function}
plot_position_coverage <- function(df,
                                   palette_vals,
                                   plot_type = "smooth",
                                   label_y_position = 0,
                                   text_gap_size = 100,
                                   loess_span = 0.01,
                                   x_gap_size = 20,
                                   free_y_scale = FALSE) {
  if ( ! plot_type %in% c("smooth", "line", "bar", "density") )
    stop("Invalid plot type")

  plt <- df %>% 
    ggplot(aes(
      x = rel_position,
      y = coverage,
      group = library
    )) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(aes(xintercept = min(rel_position) + buffer_length_bp),
                        linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(aes(xintercept = max(rel_position) - buffer_length_bp),
                        linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = palette_vals) +
    ggplot2::guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(buffer_length_bp * -1, 0, buffer_length_bp, buffer_length_bp * 2, buffer_length_bp * 3),
      labels = c(buffer_length_bp * -1, 0, buffer_length_bp, 0, buffer_length_bp)
    ) +
    labs(x = "",
         y = "Relative number of Ty1 insertions\n(normalised coverage)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.margin = unit(c(2,1,1,1), "lines"))
  
  if (free_y_scale == TRUE) {
    plt <- plt +
      ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = vars(subunit),
                        scales = "free")
  } else {
    plt <- plt +
      ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = vars(subunit)) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text",
                        x = 0 - text_gap_size,
                        y = label_y_position,
                        size = 3,
                        label = "TSS") +
      ggplot2::annotate("text",
                        x = 1000 + text_gap_size,
                        y = label_y_position,
                        size = 3,
                        label = "TTS") +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = 'on',
                               ylim = c(0, 7E-6)) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = c(0, 7E-6)
      )
  }
  
  if (plot_type == "smooth") {
    plt <- plt +
      geom_smooth(se = FALSE,
                  colour = "black",
                  method = "loess",
                  formula = y ~ x,
                  span = loess_span,
                  level = 0.98,
                  linewidth = 2) +
      geom_smooth(se = FALSE,
                  method = "loess",
                  formula = y ~ x,
                  span = loess_span,
                  level = 0.98,
                  aes(colour = library),
                  linewidth = 1.5)
  }
  else if (plot_type == "line") {
    plt <- plt +
      geom_line(colour = "black",
                linewidth = 2) +
      geom_line(aes(colour = library),
                linewidth = 1.5)
  }
  else if (plot_type == "bar") {
    plt <- plt +
      geom_bar(
        colour = "black",
        aes(fill = library),
        stat = "identity"
      )
  }
  else {
    stop("Unimplemented plot type.")
  }
  plt <- plt +
    ggplot2::geom_rect(
    xmin = buffer_length_bp - x_gap_size,
    xmax = buffer_length_bp + x_gap_size,
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 6E-6,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "white",
    alpha = 0.8,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
  return(plt)
}
```

## Butterfly plot

```{r plot-butterfly, fig.cap = "Butterfly plot showing the normalised sequencing coverage -- a proxy for the number of Ty1 insertions -- upstream and downstream of a tRNA gene. Sequencing coverage was normalised by the number of reads sequenced for each library. tRNA genes encoded on the mitochondrial chromosome were omitted."}
nucleosome_position_df <- data.frame(
  x = c(860, 685, 510, 335, 160),
  y = 0
)

p.span <- 0.08  # Controls the amount of smoothing for the default loess smoother
# (0.75 by default). Values between 0.08 and 0.05 retain the double-peak.
p.level <- 0.99  # Level of confidence interval to use (0.95 by default).
bt.cov_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subunit, group, library, proximity, strand, rel.position) %>%
  summarise(
    coverage.norm = sum(coverage.norm),
    .groups = "keep"
  ) %>% 
  plot_butterfly(annot_df = nucleosome_position_df,
                 trna_feat_df = trna_df,
                 colour_by = library,
                 colour_palette = metadata_palette_list[["library"]],
                 span = p.span,
                 level = p.level,
                 .smooth_se = TRUE,
                 .annot_size = 4)
```

The smoothing function (LOESS) greatly effects the shape and of coverage distributions in the butterfly plot. The LOESS function (default) had the best fit, with the formula `y ~ x`.
The `span` and `length` parameters used by `geom_smooth` also impacted the fit of the model. In order to preserve the double peak of Ty1 insertion per nucleosome the span was set to `r p.span` and level was set to `r p.level`.

## Insertion rate differences between strands

### Box-and-whisker plot

Next, we wanted to learn whether there was a difference in Ty1 insertion between the positive and negative strands.

```{r strand-wise-box-and-whisker, fig.cap="Comparison of normalised read depths between the positive and negative strands.", fig.height=6, fig.width=8}

bt.strand_diff_df <- bt.cov_df %>%
  group_by(group, library, trna.name, proximity, strand, subunit, strain.type, sugar) %>%
  mutate(strand = ifelse(strand == '+',
                         "positive",
                         "negative")) %>% 
  reframe(coverage.sum = sum(coverage.norm))

bt.strand_diff_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = strand, y = coverage.sum, colour = proximity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(subunit),
             cols = vars(strain.type))+ 
  labs(x = "DNA strand",
       y = "Normalised read depth") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "")) +
  theme_bw()
```

There is no significant difference between the two strands. Coverage upstream of tRNA genes is clearly greater than downstream.

### Strand insertion at each tRNA gene

```{r strand-difference-box-and-whisker, fig.cap="Coverage difference values were calculated by subtracting the coverage of the negative strand from the coverage of the positive strand for each tRNA gene. Only positions upstream of the tRNA genes were used."}

bt.strand_diff_df %>% 
  filter(proximity == "upstream",
         subunit != "Other") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "strand",
              values_from = "coverage.sum",
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  mutate(strand_diff = positive - negative) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = group,
                      y = strand_diff,
                      colour = interaction(strain.type, sugar, sep = '+'))) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = vars(subunit),
                      scales = "free_y",
                      space = "free") +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  ggplot2::guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Treatment")) +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "",
    y = "",
    # y = "Difference between positive and negative\nstrand coverage at tRNA genes"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

```

## Mutant versus wild-type

Ty1 retrotransposons use the RNA polymerase machinery to insert into the genome upstream of the genes transcribed by the respective RNA polymerase enzyme -- in this case, RNA polymerase III. The RNA polymerase III subunits  [RPC160](https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/RPC160), [RPC53](https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000002309) and [RPC34](https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/RPC34) are all necessary for transcription. To test which subunits associate with Ty1 retrotransposon's insertion machinery, each of the three subunit-encoding genes were systematically mutated and its consequent impact on insertion was analysed. A baseline of no insertion was inferred from *S. cerevisae* grown on dextrose.


```{r mutant-vs-wildtype-insertion-box-plot, fig.cap="Comparison of normalised coverage between the mutant and wild-type strains for each subunit group. For this box-plot, coverage values for only the upstream regions were used as insertion in the downstream was always less. Coverage across all tRNA genes on both strands was summed, yielding 275 data points for each library: one for each tRNA gene.", fig.height=5}
bt.cov_df %>% 
  filter(proximity == "upstream",
         subunit != "Other") %>% 
  group_by(strain.type, sugar, subunit, trna.name, group) %>% 
  reframe(coverage.sum = sum(coverage.norm)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = group,
                               y = coverage.sum,
                               colour = interaction(strain.type, sugar, sep = '+'))) +

                y = "Normalized 5'-most nucleotide coverage") +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```{r mutant-vs-wt-t-test, tab.cap="Result of a Welch's two-sided t-test under the null hypothesis that there is no difference between the tRNA coverages of mutant and wild-type strains."}

t_test <- function(df, ...) {
  t.test(
    x = df %>% 
         dplyr::filter(strain.type == "Wild-type") %>% 
         dplyr::pull(coverage.sum), 
    y = df %>% 
         dplyr::filter(strain.type == "Mutant") %>% 
         dplyr::pull(coverage.sum),
    ...
  ) %>% 
    broom::tidy() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(
      "wt.mean"="estimate1",
      "mut.mean"="estimate2"
    ) %>% 
    return()
}

subunit_wise_t_test_helper <- function(df, ...) {
  # Required columns: 
  # * strain.type: either Mutant or Wild-type
  # * group: the grouping variable to perform comparisons between MT and WT
  unique_groups <- df %>%
    filter(strain.type != "Wild-type") %>% 
    pull(group) %>% 
    unique()
  
  res_cat_df <- data.frame()
  for (group_name in unique_groups) {
    subgroup_df <- df %>% 
      filter(group == group_name | group == "WT")
    obs_matrix <- subgroup_df %>% 
      group_by(strain.type) %>% 
      tally()

    if (min(obs_matrix$n) < 3) {
      message(paste0("Skipping t-test for '", group_name, "' due to insufficient observations."))
    } else if ( nrow(obs_matrix) != 2 ) {
      message(paste0("Both mutant and wild-type were not found for '", group_name, "'."))
    } else {
      res_df <- subgroup_df %>% 
        t_test(df=.,
               ...) %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(group = group_name)
      if (nrow(res_cat_df) == 0)
        res_cat_df <- res_df
      else
        res_cat_df <- bind_rows(res_cat_df, res_df)
    }
  }
  return(res_cat_df)
}

bt.cov_t_test_res_table <- bt.cov_df %>%
  filter(sugar == "Galactose",
         subunit != "Other",
         proximity == "upstream") %>%
  group_by(strain.type, trna.name, library, subunit, group) %>%
  summarise(coverage.sum = sum(coverage.norm),
            .groups = "keep") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subunit) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ttest = purrr::map(data,
                       subunit_wise_t_test_helper,
                       paired = FALSE,
                       conf.level = 0.99,
                       alternative = "two.sided")
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(ttest) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c("subunit", "group", "statistic", "p.value", "wt.mean", "mut.mean"))) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    digits = Inf,
    col.names = c("Subunit", "Library", "T-test statistic", "p-value", "WT mean", "Mutant mean")
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_minimal()

```{r calc-trna-coverage-for-mutant-and-wt}

# Currently hard-coded for tRNA features
calculate_feature_coverage_between_mutant_and_wt <- function(df) {
  cols <- c(
    "subunit",
    "strain.type",
    "group",
    "chr",
    "strand",
    "end",
    "trna.name",
    "proximity",
    "mean_cov.norm"
  )
  
  df.wt <- df %>% 
    dplyr::filter(strain.type == "Wild-type") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(strain.type = "WT") %>%
    dplyr::select(tidyselect::all_of(cols)) %>% 
    dplyr::distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "strain.type",
                values_from = "mean_cov.norm")
  
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(strain.type == "Mutant") %>% 
    dplyr::select(tidyselect::all_of(cols)) %>% 
    dplyr::distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "strain.type",
                values_from = "mean_cov.norm") %>% 
    left_join(df.wt,
              by = c("subunit", "chr", "strand", "end", "trna.name", "proximity"),
              suffix = c('', '.wt')) %>%
    group_by(subunit, group, trna.name, proximity) %>% 
    summarise(
      wt.sum = sum(WT),
      wt.mean = mean(WT),
      mut.sum = sum(Mutant),
      mut.mean = mean(Mutant),
      .groups = "keep"
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(diff.abs = abs(mut.mean - wt.mean)) %>% 
    return()
}

  dplyr::mutate(

      .default = NA

  dplyr::filter(trna.name != "tX") %>% 
  calculate_feature_coverage_between_mutant_and_wt()

## Ty1 insertion quantification at tRNA genes

```{r nucleosome-coverage-plot}
match_trna_by_position <- function(df1, df2) {
  # df1: Data frame with at least a 'position' column
  # df2: Data frame with at least 'start', 'end', and 'trna.name' columns
  # Returns: df1 with a new column 'matched_trna.name' containing the trna.name from df2 if a match is found, NA otherwise

  # Vector to hold matched trna.names
  matched_names <- vector("character", nrow(df1))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df1))) {
    pos <- df1$position[i]
    chr <- df1$chr[i]
    
    # Find matching trna in df2 where position is within 1000 of start and end
    match_idx <- which((chr == df2$chr) & (pos >= df2$start - 1000) & (pos <= df2$end + 1000))
    
    if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
      # If multiple matches, choose the first one
      matched_names[i] <- as.character(df2$trna.name[match_idx[1]])
    } else {
      matched_names[i] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # Add matched_trna.name to df1
  df1$trna.name <- matched_names
  return(df1)
}

nuc_pos_df <- read.table(p.bt.npc_file,
                         header=FALSE,
                         col.names = c("chr", "position", "NPC", "noiseRatio"))
nuc_pos_df %>%
  filter(
    noiseRatio > 1,
    # NPC > 1
  ) %>%
  match_trna_by_position(trna_df) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(trna.name)) %>% 
  dplyr::right_join(trna_df,
                    by = c("chr", "trna.name")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rel_position = position - start,
    rel_position = case_when(
      strand == '-' ~ (rel_position * -1),
      .default = rel_position
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(rel_position) %>% 
  mutate(
    npc.mean = mean(NPC),
    npc.sum = sum(NPC)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = rel_position, y = npc.mean)) +
  geom_smooth(
    # method = "loess",
    # formula = y ~ x,
    # span = 0.1,
    # level = p.level,
    se = FALSE
  )
```

## Genome-wide Ty1 insertion site analysis

```{r low-coverage-features, fig.cap="Bar-plot with error bars representing the mean coverage (in reads per base-pair) of each feature across. Libraries grown on destrose were excluded from this figure so as to not bias the summary functions."}

hm.cov_df %>%
  extract_metadata_from_library_names() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    feature.name %in% low_cov_features,
    sugar == "Galactose"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(feature.name = reorder(feature.name, mean_cov.norm)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = feature.name, y = mean_cov.norm)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary") +
  geom_errorbar(stat = "summary",
                width = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = vars(subunit),
                      cols = vars(strain.type)) +
  labs(x = "Genome feature",
       y = "Mean coverage (reads/bp)") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

    dplyr::select(tidyselect::all_of(c("library", "feature.name", "vals"="mean_tpm"))) %>% 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "feature.name",

    tibble::column_to_rownames("library") %>%
    t(),
  meta_df = hm.meta_df,

)

### Mean TPM and coverage relationship

The following figure is to determine how the choice between TPM and coverage influences the results and potentially the interpretation.

```{r cov-tpm-scatter-plot, fig.cap="Mean coverage and TPM values are linearly correlated, and the slope of the relationship is explained by the library.", fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
hm.cov_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_cov, y = mean_tpm, colour = library)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```

The figure above shows that there is less differentiation between the different libraries when using TPM values (y-axis) compared to using coverage values (x-axis). Whether this reflects true signal or a lack of normalization in calculating coverage values is not clear.

### Insertion at rDNA locus genes


```{r rdna-locus-cov-heatmap, fig.cap = "Heatmap of genome feature mean coverage values for each library. Mean coverage was calculated by dividing the number of reads that aligned within a feature by the feature's length in base-pairs."}

rdna_locus_gene_list <- c(
  "5.8S ribosomal RNA",
  "5S rRNA",
  "NTS1(misc feature)",
  "18S rRNA",
  "NTS2(misc feature)",
  "25S rRNA"
)

for (panel in unique(hm.meta_df$subunit)) {
  draw(plot_genome_coverage_heatmap(
    cov_mat = hm.cov_df %>%
      extract_metadata_from_library_names() %>% 
      dplyr::filter(
        subunit == panel,
        feature.name %in% rdna_locus_gene_list
      ) %>% 
      dplyr::select(tidyselect::all_of(c("library", "feature.name", "vals"="mean_cov.norm"))) %>% 
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "feature.name",
                         values_from = "vals",
                         values_fill = 0) %>% 
      tibble::column_to_rownames("library") %>%
      t(),
    meta_df = hm.meta_df %>% 
      dplyr::filter(subunit == panel) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(group = ifelse(subunit == "Other",
                                   group,
                                   paste(subunit, group, sep = '-'))),
    annotations = c("strain.type", "sugar"),
    brewer_palette_name = c("Set1", "Set3")
  ))
}
```


```{r normalised-coverage-comparison-at-rdna-locus, tab.cap="Normalised sequencing coverage values at rDNA loci across strains. All deduplicated read alignments were counted in the interval 451300 - 469300 on chromosome twelve (XII) for each library. Coverage values represent the percentage of total read reads sequenced for each library."}
sample_name_map <- read.table(p.sample_id_mapping_file,
                              header = TRUE,
                              sep = "\t")
rdna_cov_df <- read.table(p.rdna_count_file,
           header = TRUE,
           sep = "\t") %>%
  separate(Library,
           int = c("runId", "barcode"),
           sep = "_") %>% 
  left_join(sample_name_map,
            by = c("runId", "barcode")) %>% 
  select(tidyselect::all_of(c("library"="uniqueId", "ReadCount"))) %>%
  extract_metadata_from_library_names() %>% 
  left_join(read_counts_df %>% 
              select(all_of(c("library", "norm_type", "seq_library_size"))),
            by="library") %>%
  mutate(coverage.norm = round(100 * ReadCount / seq_library_size, 3)) %>% 
  filter(
    norm_type == p.read_norm_type,
    !library %in% p.libs_for_filtering,
    sugar == "Galactose",
    subunit != "Other"
  ) %>%
  arrange(subunit, strain.type) %>% 
  select(all_of(c("subunit", "strain.type", "group", "coverage.norm")))

rdna_cov_df %>% 
  left_join(rdna_cov_df %>%
              filter(strain.type == "Wild-type") %>%
              select(!all_of(c("strain.type"))) %>% 
              tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group,
                                 values_from = coverage.norm),
            by = "subunit") %>% 
  mutate(diff = coverage.norm - WT) %>%
  select(all_of(c("subunit", "strain.type", "group", "coverage.norm", "diff"))) %>% 
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Subunit", "Type", "Strain", "Normalised coverage (% of raw reads)", "Difference from WT")) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_minimal()
  
```

## Coverage at genes transcribed by RNA Polymerase II

```{r separate-rna-pol-ii-gene-insertions}
rpii.cov_prepped_df <- rpii.cov_df %>%
  normalise_sequencing_library_coverage(read_counts = read_counts_df,
                                        read_norm_type = "raw") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    "coverage.raw" = coverage,
    "coverage" = coverage.norm
  ) %>%
  prep_position_wise_feature_coverage_df(
    rpii.gene_df,
    min_gene_coverage = 0,
    min_gene_read_count = 1,
    add_zero_coverage_positions = FALSE,
    summarise_by_position = TRUE
  ) %>%
  extract_metadata_from_library_names() %>%
  filter(
    subunit %in% c("RPC34", "RPC160"),
    sugar == "Galactose"
  )

for (lib_name in unique(rpii.cov_prepped_df$library)) {
  plt <- rpii.cov_prepped_df %>% 
    filter(library == lib_name) %>%
    plot_position_coverage(
      plot_type = "smooth",
      free_y_scale = TRUE,
      palette_vals = metadata_palette_list[["library"]],
      text_gap_size = 120,
      loess_span = 0.05,
      label_y_position = 9E-6
    )
  plt <- plt +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank()
      )
  plot(plt)
}
```
